title: Concrete Meridian
description: A hypnotic techno track in A minor at 130 BPM, 144 bars (about 4 minutes 26): intro, build, first main part, breakdown, rebuild, peak with an acid line, and an outro that returns to the kick alone. Four-on-the-floor drums played from a clip sequencer, an offbeat and rolling bass ducked by the kick, minor stabs and a pad on i, iv and v, a drone, and slow filter movement. Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
